props.name: workspace
props.description: Workspace name, prefilled on step 1 and recapped on step 3.

props.name: roles
props.description: Role choices of the step-2 selects.

props.name: checklist
props.description: Step-3 recap; derived from `workspace` and `invites` when omitted.

props.name: labels
props.description: UI copy; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.

props.name: initials
props.description: Avatar initials; derived from the email when omitted.

props.name: progress
props.description: `{step}` and `{total}` are replaced by the current step and the step count.

props.name: icons
props.description: Accessible names of the four workspace icons.

props.name: roleFor
props.description: `{email}` is replaced by the invitee's address.
